title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is a transitional page in Grothendieck's study of the 'structure at infinity' of the moduli spaces M_{g,ν}. The setting is a normal-crossings boundary D in the compactification. Its strata D_{d_*} are indexed by flags d_* = {d_0 > d_1 > ... > d_r ≥ 0}, as the next page makes explicit.

(1) First he comments on the preceding diagrams (280)-(281). There C^2 \ {P} and C^2 are written as homotopy pushouts (amalgamated sums) of products of C^×, D and D^× (D the disc). He notes that the 'new' elementary local types he has just introduced, the V^{Δ_i}_{P,x} (for example D×D^×), appear inside these diagrams. In modern terms, the local homotopy type near a normal-crossing point is assembled, by a Seifert–van Kampen / homotopy-colimit gluing, from deleted tubular neighbourhoods of the branches.

(2) He then announces a programme with three parts:
- describe the functoriality ('variance') of the local types V^{d'_0}_{d_*,d''_0} as the pair d'_0 ≥ d''_0 in d_* varies (a struck-out first version parametrised this by pairs d'_* ⊂ d_*);
- describe the corresponding functoriality of their fundamental groupoids Π_1;
- show how, from these types and groupoids, one can reconstruct all the 'modular types' attached to the stratification, i.e. the strata together with their fundamental groupoids.
In modern language this is a dévissage of a stratified space: recovering the global (pro-)homotopy type, or the stratified fundamental groupoid, from the strata and their homotopy links / punctured tubular neighbourhoods and the maps between them.

(3) Before doing so, he proposes to examine the structure of these 'spaces'. He begins by introducing the normal bundle of D_{d_*} in D_{d''_0}, with the definition Ň_{d_*,d''_0} := Ň_{D_{d_*},D_{d''_0}}. The next page builds from this the canonical filtration Ň_{d_*} ⊃ Ň_{d_*,d_1} ⊃ ... ⊃ 0, with ranks d_i, and the exact sequences 0 → Ň_{D_{d_*},D_{d'_*}} → Ň_{d_*} → Ň_{d'_*}|D_{d_*} → 0. These are the standard normal-bundle sequences for a chain of local immersions of normal-crossing strata.

The page contains no proofs, only planning and a definition.

ideas.what: Local homotopy types at a normal-crossings point (deleted tubular neighbourhoods V^{Δ_i}_{P,x}) used as building blocks in amalgamated-sum (homotopy pushout) descriptions of C^2 and C^2 minus a point
ideas.modern_name: Homotopy colimit / van Kampen decomposition of links of normal-crossing strata
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard (van Kampen; links of normal-crossing divisors, e.g. Deligne's mixed Hodge theory setting)

ideas.what: Programme of reconstructing the 'modular types' (strata plus fundamental groupoids) from local types V^{d'_0}_{d_*,d''_0}, their functoriality in (d'_0 ≥ d''_0), and associated Π_1
ideas.modern_name: Dévissage of stratified spaces; homotopy links and exit-path / stratified fundamental groupoids
ideas.usually_credited_to: Quinn (homotopy links, 1988); MacPherson, Treumann, Lurie (exit-path categories); in the M_{g,n} context, Teichmüller-tower / Grothendieck–Teichmüller literature (Ihara, Nakamura, Lochak–Schneps)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984), §5 on dévissage of stratified structures and the structure at infinity of M_{g,ν}; also La Longue Marche

ideas.what: Normal bundle of D_{d_*} in D_{d''_0} and the canonical filtration of the normal bundle of a normal-crossing stratum
ideas.modern_name: Normal bundle filtration of normal-crossings strata (splitting into line bundles of branches)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a planning page. It restates the dévissage programme for the stratified structure at infinity of M_{g,ν} already outlined in Esquisse d'un programme, plus a routine normal-bundle definition. Nothing here appears to be new or uncredited.
transcription_corrections: The inserted condition probably reads 'd'_0, d''_0 ∈ d_*, d'_0 ≥ d''_0' (∈ rather than ⊂). The struck text is a parametrisation by a pair '(d_*, d'_* ⊂ d_*)'.
'ces "espaces" Hermitiques' is more likely 'ces "espaces" heuristiques'. 'prenant' is probably 'prenons' (or 'pensons à').
In the last lines, 'dans' and 'soit Ň_{d_*,d'_0}' appear struck out. The retained definition is Ň_{d_*,d''_0} =def Ň_{D_{d_*},D_{d''_0}}; the trailing 'fibré normal' and '(282)' are struck.
'Avant de rag[arder]' is struck and replaced by 'd'examiner en détail la'. 'je voudrais regarder un peu' replaces a struck word.
